perception: Parse categories by splitting object keys at the final underscore; instance suffixes are not persistent identities.
Scene Z is category-nominal. Neither Z changes nor disappearance certifies grasp, delivery, or failure.
Reassociate baskets spatially and select work from fresh RGB detections after each completed release.
manipulation: Use normalized arm-specific downward quaternions and the supplied contact-tool offset.
Give closure additional settling, retain the closed command during transport, and split longer lateral transfers.
Use geometry-derived interior basket targets, a separate final descent to release height, open settling, and a vertical retreat.
Tentative release locations may guide spacing but must not be counted as confirmed deliveries.
recovery: Only an explicit no_collision_free_path result establishes zero execution and permits the bounded empty-handed arm fallback.
After an exception or other primitive error, stop without additional physical commands.
Permit at most two attempts near a positively reobserved category/location, within a twelve-cycle overall bound.
memory.evaluation: Primitive returns and call counts are not success certificates; the independent evaluator determines task outcome.

rationale: This policy addresses the reported failure modes with additional closed-gripper settling, shorter long-distance transfers, destination hovering followed by a separate release descent, and open settling before retreat. It removes fixed world-frame release offsets and spaces repeated placements within observed basket interiors. A bounded assignment calculation reduces unnecessary transfers, while fresh category-and-position reassociation permits limited recovery without trusting instance names or nominal height. All physical actions use the supplied public API, and uncertain execution ends the policy without further manipulation.
